# State inside a recursion is refused on bubbletea, with a position, rather
# than emitted.
#
# bubbletea keeps no state of an instance's own, so a stateful component is
# spliced where it is written with a cell per copy -- and a recursion is never
# spliced: it is rendered as a function per call, which has nowhere to keep a
# cell. A recursive component's own var reached the Model as a field nothing
# declared (`m.hits undefined`), and a stateful component written in its body
# reached the view as a node it drew as an empty string, silently.
#
# The same programs build on html, which keeps an instance's state in its
# factory.

! sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out out own.sngl
stderr 'own.sngl:4:5: the recursive component "frame" declares state of its own \("hits"\)'

! sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out out2 callee.sngl
stderr 'callee.sngl:11:16: "Counter" has state of its own and is written in the recursive component "frame"'

sngl generate --platform html --out out3 own.sngl
sngl generate --platform html --out out4 callee.sngl

# A lifetime written in the recursive component's own body is state of its own
# too: its handle is a cell. Only a callee's lifetime was asked about, so this
# built and the ticks were never delivered. The timer is the platform's
# primitive by then, so the position is the declaration's.
! sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out out5 lifetime.sngl
stderr 'lifetime.sngl:10:1: the recursive component "frame" places a timer or effect in its own body'
sngl generate --platform html --out out6 lifetime.sngl

-- own.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component frame(n int) node {
    var hits = 0

    vbox {
        button(text="level {n} {hits}", @click { hits += 1 })
        if n > 0 {
            frame(n=n - 1)
        }
    }
}

window {
    var depth = 2

    frame(n=depth)
}
-- callee.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component Counter node {
    var hits = 0

    button(text="{hits}", @click { hits += 1 })
}

component frame(n int) node {
    vbox {
        Counter()
        if n > 0 {
            frame(n=n - 1)
        }
    }
}

window {
    var depth = 2

    frame(n=depth)
}
-- lifetime.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import time "sngl:time"

var ticks = 0

func tick() {
    ticks += 1
}

component frame(n int) node {
    vbox {
        text(value="level {n} {ticks}")
        time.timer(interval=100ms, @tick { tick() })
        if n > 0 {
            frame(n=n - 1)
        }
    }
}

window {
    var depth = 2

    frame(n=depth)
}
